$description: Core AFDS sample tokens. Spacing and typography share one modular scale rooted at 1rem so that user font-size changes propagate through both type and space.

scale.$description: Modular scale steps. Each step is expressed in rem so that it tracks the user's root font size.

step-0.$description: The seed of the scale: one line of body text.

step-minus-1.$description: One step below the seed. Not used for body copy.

space.$description: Spacing tokens are aliases of scale steps rather than independent values, so spacing cannot drift away from the type scale.

tight.$description: Alias reference to the scale step below the seed.

default.$description: Alias reference to the seed step. This is the default Stack gap.

loose.$description: Alias reference to one step above the seed.

typography.$description: Typographic values. Line height is unitless so that it scales with font size.

body-size.$description: Alias reference to the seed step. Body copy is never smaller than this.

body-line-height.$description: Unitless line height for body copy, meeting the WCAG 1.4.12 text-spacing expectation.

measure.$description: Maximum inline size of a text block, in character widths. The ch unit follows the font's character width as font size changes.

colour.$description: Colour tokens are candidates for contrast pairing, not guarantees. DTCG carries values, not contrast relationships, so the pairing constraint lives in the component specification.

ink.$description: Default body text colour, intended for use on colour.surface.
